description: Conformance vectors for the csv/manual natural-sort used by local_curricmap (and any future re-implementation). Rules: tokenise into digit and non-digit runs; digit runs compare numerically (leading zeros ignored, then shorter-vs-longer raw run as tie-break via full strcmp); non-digit runs compare case-insensitively; a digit run sorts before a non-digit run at the same token position; a string that is a prefix of another sorts first; final tie-break is a case-sensitive full comparison for stable ordering.
source: sofia_api_explorer umbrella repo, test_vectors/natural_sort.json. Update both copies together.
